title: BreatheSafe
summary: BreatheSafe is a microservices platform that turns real-time air-quality and personal health data into personalized health-risk predictions using an ensemble ML model. Its ML service notebook uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata schema to generate synthetic tabular training data for the health-risk model.
